title: IMAGINE 2026
seo_title: IMAGINE 2026: Lennon & Beatles Tribute in Springfield
description: IMAGINE is a Springfield tradition where local and regional musicians reimagine songs by John Lennon and The Beatles in their own styles, with a lineup including Big Beat Club, Guinevere Goodwin, Truett & The Traitors, The Mixtapes, little jones, and Jake Wesley Rogers. It is the Gillioz Theatre's largest annual fundraiser, supporting preservation of the 1926 theatre and its year-round programming. It takes place Saturday, December 5, 2026 at 7:30 PM at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central, E Springfield, Missouri, with doors at 6:30 PM.
